28.t: The manufacturer tested Pole Position II upright games and found that in an arcade environment, upright games have excellent earnings with switches set to sit-down game settings.

If you have an Atari PCB, the switch which controls game play options is located at 9L. (It is located at 9E if you have Namco PCBs.) We recommend that the game be set for 120 seconds preliminary game time, that the preliminary rank and extended rank levels are set to "B" (moderate difficulty), that the game is set for 5 laps per game, and that the game is played at high speed. To select these options, set the toggle switches as listed in Table 10.

If you have an Atari PCB, the switch which controls game price options and special play options is located at 9J. (It is located at 7E if you have Namco PCBs.) We recommend that the game be set for 50 cents per game, that the unit of speed is miles per hour, that the sound is on in the attract mode, and that the screen displays normal action (not frozen!) To select these options, set the toggle switches as listed in Table 11.
Please refer to CO-218-12 for more information about game options.
